evidence_class.instructions: Classify command_or_pr.text against measured HTTP/CI facts in state.measured. Do not invent LIVE. HTTP 200 is REACHABLE, not LIVE.

criteria.MEASURED: Claims match labeled evidence. No LIVE stamp, no Hub-as-source, Lambda stays Conjecture 1.
criteria.HOLD: Ambiguous wording or missing proof. Operator must decide. Includes low confidence.
criteria.BLOCK: Would mint LIVE, invent joules, treat Hub as source, call Lambda a theorem, or treat unsigned receipts as live.
criteria.UNAVAILABLE: No key, no HTTP answer, or state is insufficient. Never treat as PASS.

claims_live.instructions: Text stamps LIVE or is-live from reachability alone (HTTP 200, Space Running, likes, first paint).

invents_joules.instructions: Text invents energy, free energy, or joules without a live exporter delta.

treats_hf_as_source.instructions: Text treats Hugging Face as canonical source instead of GitHub szl-holdings.

lambda_as_theorem.instructions: Text treats Lambda uniqueness or Conjecture 1 as a proven theorem or trust=1.0.

unsigned_as_live.instructions: Text treats UNSIGNED, UNSIGNED-honest, HASH-LINKED, or ABSENT signer as live signed proof.

overclaim_severity.instructions: How severe is the honesty failure if this text were published.
criteria: No overclaim. MEASURED or explicit UNAVAILABLE.
Explicit LIVE mint, invented joules, Hub-as-source, Lambda-as-theorem, or unsigned-as-live. BLOCK.
